message.reasoning: The user wants to find rewards for different missions in Fortnite on PlayStation. We need to call the function game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation", mission maybe unspecified or we can list all missions first. The user didn't specify a particular mission, so we might list all missions first using game_missions_list. Then we can get rewards for each mission. But the user specifically says "尋找在Playstation平台上玩Fortnite時不同任務和獎益的獎勵。" That means "Find the rewards for different missions and benefits when playing Fortnite on PlayStation." So likely they want a list of missions and their rewards. We can call game_missions_list to get all missions. Then for each mission, call game_rewards_get with mission param. But we don't have to do multiple calls; we can just call game_rewards_get with mission='' to get all rewards? The function signature says mission default to ''. So calling with mission='' might return all rewards. Let's do that. We'll call game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation", mission='', trophy=''.
